# Vibe Coding With Fred

> > Cincinnati-based freelance developer Fred offers MVP development, AI-assisted coding tutorials, and security audits for Laravel, Flask, and JavaScript applications.

Fred specializes in rapid prototyping and AI-powered development workflows, providing hands-on tutorials for building real-world projects with modern web technologies. The site features practical guides for Laravel, Flask, and vanilla JavaScript, along with professional services including MVP development starting at $99 and security audits for AI-generated codebases.
